title: El taxi
goal: Agree the fare before you get in, not after
culture: There is no meter in any taxi in this country and there never has been. The fare is agreed through the window before you open the door, and asking afterwards is a different and much worse conversation with your bags already inside.

beats.good: Name the place, never the street. Al mercado is a complete address in this town.

beats.objective: Ask the fare — through the window
beats.good: You asked the cargador this in the market and it is the same question here. No meter, so the number happens now or it happens badly later.
Fifty is a fair town fare. Haggling a taxi here is not the ritual it is in a market — agree it and get in.

beats.es: Así me gusta, que pregunte antes de subir. Muchos no.
beats.good: Antes de subir — before getting in. He approves because the ones who ask afterwards are the ones who end up arguing on the pavement.
